notes.title: 4 Player Local Coop / Splitscreen, Major performance and QOL Improvements.
notes.content:
[h1]Up to 4 Player Split screen Supported[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40059056/65f4d91600f262228b775cd9fdc29c99392044d7.png[/img]

If you have 2 displays enabled, the 4 extra windows will split between your 2 displays in whatever way gets most coverage of your displays. 

If you have 2 displays, you can even split 2ndary display 4, and keep main display as a 5th full display which can be used in modes 2 to 4 for building level tools while 4 other players play with xbox controllers!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40059056/6a4f7b4248442a27d639f3b900b7ce4b287f26aa.png[/img]


[h2] Set the desired number of players in the level settings here, toggle number of Rockets and Use Extra Windows to the desired number and save and restart [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40059056/e042dbec12e113368540e4d1125146b67336e427.png[/img]

[h2]On the in game escape menu there are now buttons to display the rocket controls for xbox controller and for keyboard controls.  You can set default controls for the rockets in level settings or adjust on the fly on the in game escape menu[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40059056/229d3b74c27ead39dfce764eccfbe512976612ef.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40059056/f2cb851ff27259381847539b6e779ce43a45a1ea.png[/img]

[h2]Main Menu has been overhauled and now shows a random background / animation and you can see auto generated level previews on any level you entered recently
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40059056/8cd2920595089c61187531042193882b68d78631.png[/img][/h2]

notes.title: Improved - Sound Effects - Rocket Controls - GUI
notes.content:
[b]AMMO & FUEL LIMITS[/b]
You can set limits on Fuel and Ammo for the Rocket Ship
Can set HP Bar, Ammo Bar and or Fuel Bar to show how much you have used, have left:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40059056/3d6fcf304b4c12d8b0d1bc393c5c0456b4a18e24.png[/img]

[b]Added Fuel and Ammo Objects which when touched restore Fuel/Ammo[/b]
Can be customized to restore any amount or percent, and be limited to how many times they can be used etc:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40059056/a795f7727c81bb7884fc3f9fb246388704d02451.png[/img]

Fuel / Ammo Limits can be set here in the Level Options/Settings
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40059056/1c42210de79c6d7e60fda6618a931aaf0eb9eb47.png[/img]


[b]IMPROVED CONTROLS FOR ROCKET[/b]
With the addition of Fuel limits, the Rocket Ships controls and specifically the grappling rope have been greatly improved so that mobility is still reasonable possible if you run out of fuel.

Removed the Cooldown on rocket ship ability to throw bombs, bombs cost 3 ammo points instead of having cool down.

Added ability for rocket ship to launch missles like the missle launcher object. These cost 4 ammo points.

[b]SOUND EFFECTS OVERHAUL[/b]
Many Objects now have their own sound effects when they collide and or activate an ability.
Glass looking objects make glass clinking sounds when colliding, metal objects metal sounds etc.
Sounds originating from objects have a sound range and sound quieter the farther away from the center screen they are etc.
Sounds from objects have a slight cool down to prevent anoying sound spamming 

Misc:
Added shadows to menu.
Fixed various bugs.

notes.title: special obj ability values and joint strength options
notes.content:
1) Portals images/function  improved

2) special object ability values all adjustable

portal - abv1 controls what portal the portal links to

canons/grapple/stickeyblock
 - abv1 is the cooldown between rate of fire
   abv2 is the strength of fire multiplier
Repel Bag/Attract Ball
 - abv1 Force Range
 - abv2 Force Power 
 - abv3 Show Visual
Rocket Launcher
 - abv1 Fire cooldown
Laser
 - abv1 Laser Range
 - abv2 Number of bounces
 - abv3 Laser Speed
BOMB 
 - abv1 explosion sensitivity
WINDBLOCK
 - Wind Power
 - Wind Range
 - Show Visual
TEKIBOX
 - Spawn Cooldown

3) Joint Strength multiplier

notes.content:

zoom in/out with mouse scroll or xbox controllers LR buttons
adjust all objects size to any scale - obj special abilities scale with the size where applicable
buttons with many choices now have multiple choice window
explosions imrpoved - fireworks
special shaped objects heart, cross, gear
special object anvil is 5x denser

notes.title: Three New Features in Freedom Physics
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added zoom in / zoom out with mouse scroll and controller L/R buttons
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40059056/c6e722c60a44273857820a659e54fdb8fb280601.png[/img]
[*] Added easy to add more objects, paste images in /img/rectangles or circles folder for extra objects to your level
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40059056/bde5f7b7027d108bc9188da1dc9eaf421e2d5545.png[/img]
[*] Added "Teki" enemies that seek out and try to destroy player controlled objects. They can be spawned individually or spawn a "Teki Box" which will periodically spawn more of them slowly and randomly.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40059056/411640aa941ece44c732e50365b160c156b7be2e.png[/img]
[/list]
